CoupleCloudRoom.title: CoupleCloudRoom
CoupleCloudRoom.description: Real-time zero-knowledge E2EE bonded room connecting at most two authenticated partners via a permanently unique 6-digit couple code, Host secondary confirmation, and immutable ECDH P-256 public key exchange. Room documents are never deleted so a generated code can never be reused by another couple.

coupleCode.description: 6-digit globally unique numeric room code matching the document ID.

creatorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the Host partner who created the room (immutable).

creatorName.description: Display name of the room creator (1-32 characters, immutable after creation).

creatorPublicKey.description: Base64 X.509 SPKI ECDH P-256 public key of the Host partner (immutable once set; private key never leaves device).

partnerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the approved joining partner (empty string until Host approves, immutable once set).

partnerName.description: Display name of the approved joining partner (0-32 characters, immutable once approved).

partnerPublicKey.description: Base64 X.509 SPKI ECDH P-256 public key of the approved partner (promoted from pendingPartnerPublicKey on Host approval, immutable once set).

pendingPartnerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of a partner awaiting Host secondary confirmation (empty string when no request is pending).

pendingPartnerName.description: Display name of a partner awaiting Host secondary confirmation (0-32 characters).

pendingPartnerPublicKey.description: Base64 X.509 SPKI ECDH P-256 public key of the pending partner awaiting Host approval.

memberUids.description: Bounded list of 1 to 2 Firebase Auth UIDs belonging to the bonded couple.

spiceLevel.description: Shared couple vibe/spice level synced live between both devices.

status.description: Room lifecycle state; WAITING accepts a join request -> PENDING_APPROVAL awaits Host Allow/Decline -> CONNECTED unlocks zero-knowledge ECDH play; UNPAIRED permanently locks and retires the code.

blockCount.description: Monotonically increasing total number of encrypted blockchain blocks committed to this room.

latestBlockHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the most recently mined encrypted block.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on room creation (immutable).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on every room update.

CoupleEncryptedBlock.title: CoupleEncryptedBlock
CoupleEncryptedBlock.description: Immutable, append-only, non-deletable ECDH-P256 + HKDF-SHA256 + AES-256-GCM + Proof-of-Work blockchain packet carrying an encrypted couple game move, activity turn, or handshake between two bonded phones.

senderUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the sender (must match request.auth.uid).

senderName.description: Sanitized display name of the sender (1-32 characters).

memberUids.description: Denormalized list of 1 to 2 bonded member UIDs for fast local security rule evaluation.

blockIndex.description: Monotonic index of this block in the couple blockchain ledger.

actionType.description: Type of encrypted couple activity turn or lifecycle event.

encryptedPacket.description: Zero-knowledge ECDH + AES-256-GCM + HMAC-SHA256 encrypted KRIMOON:BCHAIN: ciphertext envelope.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on block creation.

/coupleRooms/{coupleCode}.description: Root collection of permanently unique 2-partner couple rooms with Host approval gating and immutable ECDH P-256 public key exchange, keyed by their 6-digit coupleCode.

/coupleRooms/{coupleCode}/blocks/{blockI.description: Immutable, non-deletable append-only stream of zero-knowledge encrypted blockchain move envelopes for a couple room.
